# School Projects India

> English-language printable paper models and school craft projects for families and teachers in India.

The site includes habitat dioramas, science models and assembly guides. Product pages state current prices and purchase details. The road safety model listed below is free; the water cycle tutorial is free to read, while its printable template is sold separately. PDFs are digital downloads, not physical products.

## Free resources

- [Road safety model](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/road-safety-model.html): Paper traffic light, zebra crossing, car, children and road signs; free printable PDF.
- [Water cycle assembly guide](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/how-to-make-water-cycle-model.html): Illustrated instructions for assembling the water cycle model.

## Projects

- [All school projects](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/): Browse science and habitat models.
- [Water cycle project](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/water-cycle-project.html): Printable water cycle model and purchase details.
- [Volcano project](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/volcano-school-project.html): Printable volcano model.
- [Forest habitat project](https://schoolprojectsindia.com/forest-habitat-project.html): Forest habitat paper diorama.
